entries.logic: Overrides system commands by defining local functions with the same name. Only effective within the same script context.
entries.rationale: Allows for deterministic testing of scripts that depend on non-deterministic system state.

entries.logic: Compares expected vs actual values using simple if/else blocks and returns status codes for suite aggregation.
entries.implementation: if [[ "$exp" == "$act" ]]; then pass; else fail; fi
entries.rationale: Provides immediate feedback on code regressions without heavy third-party dependencies.
